description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” on the x-axis and two performance metrics on dual y-axes: “Perplexity” (left, linear scale from 4.2 to 4.7) and “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” (right, linear scale from 40 to 100). Four lines are plotted: “Perplexity” (solid orange line with circle markers) starts at ~4.6 at 10% sequence ratio, drops sharply to ~4.3 at 40%, then fluctuates slightly before rising to ~4.4 at 100%. “Full Cache PPL” (dashed maroon line) remains flat at ~4.38 across all sequence ratios. “GPU Mem. Ratio” (solid blue line with circle markers) increases gradually from ~42% at 10% to ~55% at 80%, then jumps steeply to ~100% at 100%. “Full Cache GPU Mem.” (dashed blue line) is constant at 100% across all sequence ratios. The plot demonstrates how varying the recent sequence ratio affects model perplexity and GPU memory usage under the PyramidInfer compression scheme.
